title: Al-Tanbih fi al-Fiqh al-Shafi'i
author: abu-ishaq-al-shirazi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shirazi's short manual of Shafi'i law, stating rulings without their proofs so that a student could hold the whole law in memory. It counts among the five most important books of the school's middle period.
historicalContext: Composed at the Nizamiyya in Baghdad, al-Tanbih was memorised and commented on for centuries; al-Nawawi wrote a commentary on it as well as on al-Muhadhdhab.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
